Sofia — quick internal note and modeling guidance.

1) Cost levers: if SKU-B is more compute-intensive (we've seen this with similar health workloads), moving list price to SKU-C (less intensive) improves margin but reduces partner absolute commission unless we increase percentage. We should show both approaches: keep partner % constant and show dollars, then hold partner $ constant and show % change.

2) Commission sweep idea: run a monotonic sweep across commission percentages (15% -> 30% in 1% steps) for the Base usage case to show sensitivity. That gives procurement a clear range and helps them negotiate the reseller target.

3) Private-offer mechanics: make sure the packet calls out that for AWS/GCP private offers we can set list price per SKU and attach a per-SKU partner_percent field in our downstream billing mapping; the pass-through timing varies by cloud and affects cashflow (note: GCP has ~7-10 day settlement delta we should flag).

I'll take the modeling lead on the commission sweep and produce the CSV (redwood_scenario_matrix.csv). Naomi — can you sanity-check assumptions for partner tax with respect to pass-through? Irene — I'll ping you separately on invoice routing notes.

— Ben
